title: Understanding Model Risk
text: The risk of a model is calculated as the sum of the squared bias, the variance, and the squared standard deviation of the noise.

title: Formula for Model Risk
text: The formula for model risk is: Risk $$=$$ $${Bias}^2$$ + Variance + $${Noise}^2$$. Use this formula to find the maximum acceptable noise.
